item.title: Vet Tech Capybara Expresses Glands Not Feelings
item.description: A deadpan capybara in scrubs and a stethoscope who expresses glands, not feelings. A funny gift for vet techs, vet assistants and veterinary students who keep it strictly professional. Find it on stickers, mugs and t-shirts. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Calm Capybara Holding Space and Snacks Therapist
item.description: A calm capybara sits upright with a little bag of snacks, holding space for everyone and holding treats too. It makes a funny gift for therapists, counselors and mental health pros. Find it on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
